chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from Saʿd ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about al-witr: is it separation or joining? He said: separation.

key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the witr prayer performed in the night prayer sequence
key_terms.وَصْلٌ: joining one prayer unit to another without separation

ai.seo_question: Should al-witr be performed separately from the two rakʿahs of al-shafʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal ruling concerning how the witr prayer is performed in relation to the two rakʿahs of shafʿ. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that it is to be performed separately, indicating a separation between the two rakʿahs of al-shafʿ and al-witr.
